steps_taken: Opened the authenticated V4 GIS page and enabled the Beacons layer.
Clicked the visible map marker for beacon 447720159336 and confirmed its beacon detail dialog.
Used the star control to add 447720159336; the card changed to Remove from favourites.
Opened Favourites; 447720159336 appeared in the filtered list and the view showed Favourites (1).
Used the star control again to remove 447720159336; the filtered view showed No favourite Beacons yet.

criteria.criterion: On a visible beacon, use the star control to add it; the beacon appears in Favourites.
evidence: Star control changed to Remove from favourites.

criteria.criterion: Use the star control again to remove the beacon; it no longer appears in Favourites.
evidence: Remove from favourites control was used on 447720159336.
Favourites filter showed No favourite Beacons yet.
